brief:
Palestinian consumer protection teams from the economy ministry in Gaza Strip destroyed quantities of expired and spoiled foodstuffs deemed unfit for human consumption, Shehab Wire reported. The teams conducted the operation during intensive inspection rounds across markets, warehouses, and retail outlets in Gaza and Khan Younis.

The campaign reflects the national economy ministry's ongoing enforcement of food safety regulations across the territory. Consumer protection officials regularly conduct market inspections to identify and remove contaminated or expired products from circulation before they reach consumers.
